answers.how: The cat moves about 193 px in 2.042 s, giving 0.00755 m/px. The rear chair is about 89 px wide.
The teacher's table spans about 318 px; multiplying by the cat-derived scale of 0.00755 m/px gives its length.
The rear wall measures about 346 px from the ceiling junction to the floor. Used the cat-derived scale of 0.00755 m/px.
A local fit to airplane positions around 1 s gives a speed of about 728 px/s. Converted using 0.00755 m/px.
A local curved fit to airplane positions around 1 s gives an acceleration magnitude of about 1245 px/s². Converted using the cat's motion scale.
A local fit around 1.25 s gives velocity components of approximately 606 and 215 px/s, converted using 0.00755 m/px.
A local fit around 1.25 s gives acceleration components of approximately -470 and 270 px/s². Their magnitude was converted using 0.00755 m/px.
The cat's horizontal extent, including its tail, is about 88–89 px. Used the scale derived from its known speed.
The cat measures about 65 px vertically from its raised tail to its paws. Used the cat-derived scale of 0.00755 m/px.
The clock's outer diameter is about 51 px. Used the cat-derived scale of 0.00755 m/px.
